insight: Node.js 25.8 crypto API missing createCertificate and createSelfSignedSubject - use openssl CLI instead for certificate generation
@fastify/websocket doesn't export Socket type - use simple interface { remoteAddress?: string } for connection validation instead

The mid-panel widget system allows plugins to contribute UI elements to a horizontal bar in the TUI. Each widget needs an id, label, and getContent() function. Multiple widgets are rendered side-by-side with " │ " separators. The system is extensible - any plugin can offer a widget.

Phase 3.3 knowledge registry implementation went smoothly. The coordinator-beacon sync pattern (push/pull with upsert) is consistent with the existing persona/skill sync pattern, making integration straightforward.
